pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
Hybrid melee/thrown weapon. Attack speed 1.6. Every attack is a guaranteed critical hit (jump-crit sound).

• Melee damage: 9. Can strip logs.
• Thrown: hold right-click to charge, release to throw. Retrievable.
• 80% dodge chance while held (main or offhand).
• Executes mobs below 30% HP.

Repair: gold ingots.

Ender Doll synergy: execute threshold rises from 25% to 55%.
